name: whatsapp-assistant
description: Local WhatsApp MCP tools for Codex on macOS: scoped text reads, confirmed replies and separately authorized experimental scheduled sends.

interface.shortDescription: WhatsApp MCP for Codex on macOS.
interface.longDescription: Find and summarize selected existing WhatsApp text chats through a local OpenWA/Chrome daemon. Codex-focused stable community source release with limited existing-client live evidence; Claude and other MCP clients are experimental. Interactive replies require separate confirmation; experimental scheduled sends require secret prior authorization. Tool results enter your AI client's context and may reach its provider. Fresh installation and recovery are untested; not an official integration.
defaultPrompt: Summarize recent messages in the selected chat.
Draft a reply and wait for my confirmation.
